description: This file defines a Java servlet class 'UpdateStatus' that handles HTTP POST requests to update the status of a sale/order in the online grocery ordering system. It retrieves parameters from the request, calls a database utility method to update the status, and redirects or forwards based on success or failure.

classes.name: UpdateStatus
classes.description: Servlet class handling POST requests to update sale status

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to update the sale status based on request parameters
